request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:WINDMILL

layers.text: Change only the colours and the sail cloth of this windmill: the tower becomes dark slate-grey stone (#5a5f6b), the cone roof near-black charcoal (#2b2b31), the four sails become ragged torn charcoal-grey cloth with holes and tattered edges on dark wooden arms, and the small window glows violet (#a221ee). Nothing is red, cream or terracotta any more. Keep the windmill's shape, size, the X of four sails, the door, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
